# Quality of life

The primary QoL presentation is selected only by the OS decision artifact.  No
credible interval is recomputed here.  If that artifact is missing, the report
does not choose a QoL primary.

```{r}
#| label: qol-decision
#| results: asis

qol_decision <- read_qol_analysis_decision(root = report_root)
cat("**QoL decision:** ", qol_primary_label(qol_decision), "\n\n", sep = "")
if (!is.null(qol_decision$reason)) {
  cat("**Decision source:** ", qol_decision$reason, "\n\n", sep = "")
}
report_render_section("qol", root = report_root)
```
